entries.note: What's new Open your hosted workspace in the desktop app. The Workspace menu switches between this computer and your hosted workspace. Sign-in and sign-out are separate, and local data is not copied. This preview has source and automated checks; an installed build and hosted staging account have not been checked. Choose a cloud computer provider. Use Boat or Muapi. Muapi computers are shell-only and charge against your Muapi credits while running. The provider tests use a mocked API; live Muapi use has not been checked. Build workflows visually. Add notes and shapes with their toolbars, and see validation for workflow connections. Search Pixeltable's public documentation through the Community marketplace without an account or API key. Installers macOS Apple silicon DMG: signed with Developer ID and notarized. entries.title: Mobile: version 0.3.0
entries.note: This update lets you manage agents and rooms from your phone. It also lets you pair over your local network without HTTPS, and it fixes the QR scanner. What's new Create and edit agents from the phone. This needs a phone paired with the "Chat, files and agents" ( manage ) scope. Deleting an agent stays in the web app. Create, edit and delete rooms. You can set instructions and routing, change members, hold or resume a room, and delete it after typing its name. If the member list changed on the server while you were editing, the server refuses your edit. Plain http:// pairing on your own network. Addresses like localhost , 192.168.x.x , 10.x.x.x and *.local now work. Any other address still needs HTTPS. Fixes The QR scanner works in release builds. entries.title: Mobile: version 0.2.0 (versionCode 2)
entries.note: Android preview of the Suparagent phone app. Signed with the same key as 0.1.0, so it installs over it. New Search your conversations, with results that open the matching message Tables in answers, scrolling sideways when wide A look that matches the web app: same colors, fonts and agent pictures Conversation screen like the web's, with a jump-to-latest button Guided pairing: numbered steps, QR code first, and a check of the server address before any code is sent Files: browse the files an agent made, preview text and images, and share or save any file Larger touch targets throughout Needs A server that is reachable over HTTPS. This build refuses plain http:// addresses. For Files, pair with a code made with Access: Chat and files (Settings → Devices), and turn on local execution on the server.
